caption:
Alex Hormozi scaled a gym chain to 6 locations. Then he walked away from it.

What he did next is the part people skip when they tell this story.

He started fixing other people's gyms. In person. One at a time. By hand.

More than 32 turnarounds, over roughly two years, before Gym Launch became a licensing business at all.

Only then did he package it. The system he sold wasn't designed in a room — it was the written-down version of something he'd already done 32 times.

Most people do it backwards. They build the system first, then go looking for proof it works.

That's why their offer sounds right and converts badly. It was never tested against a real customer with real money on the line.

Do the reps. Then productise.

📌 Send this to the person who's been building their course or their framework for six months and hasn't sold it once.
